title: Setup → Settings: help text shows engineer values (env var names, enum keys, defineStack calls) instead of business wording (#27521 row 2)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 2 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: an administrator in Setup → Settings. What happens: the help under each setting reads like a code comment. Authentication's help reads `invite_only` / `email_domain` / `open` and `OS_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`; Feature Flags reads `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED=true`; Mail mentions `sys_email`; the Webhooks subtitle reads `defineStack({ webhooks })` / `defineWebhook()` / "webhook auto-enqueuer"; an inherited value's badge names the layer "Tenant". Reach: every administrator opening Settings, today.

## Mechanism

- `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/auth.manifest.ts`, `feature-flags.manifest.ts`, `mail.manifest.ts` and their `translations/*` (`help` strings).
- The `sourceLabels.tenant` string (`packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/en.ts`, `sourceLabels`).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/sys-webhook.object.ts` (object description shown as the Webhooks subtitle).

Measured at `main` @ `561b7642`, re-driven (stock `examples/app-showcase --seed-admin`, admin, Chromium 1440×900).

## Wanted

Business wording in `help` and the subtitle; the technical detail (env var, enum key, API call) behind a "learn more" docs link rather than in the sentence. The inherited-value badge names the layer in the administrator's terms.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Setup → Settings → Authentication, Feature Flags and Mail help, and the Webhooks subtitle, carry no env var name, enum key, object API name or code call in the sentence (en and the shipped packs).
- [ ] Where technical detail is kept, it sits behind a docs link, not inline.
- [ ] The inherited-value badge does not read "Tenant".

Refs #27521
